titulo: Asking the user for input in the middle of the call: MRTR (InputRequiredResult)
lead: Book, pay, delete: an action with consequences needs a yes from a person. In the 2026-07-28 revision, the server no longer opens its own request to ask. It returns input_required, the client asks the user, and repeats the call with the answer. In this lesson you see both rounds and the path of the no.
objetivo: make the tool with consequences ask for confirmation mid-call with input_required and act only after the yes.

aprende.t: The two rounds: input_required and the call repeated with the answer
acceptedContent and inputResponse: reading the yes, the no, and the absence
The client must declare that it knows how to ask (elicitation)

hero_alt: Out-of-focus hand about to press a confirmation button, next to an idle industrial robot waiting.

secoes.sub: Click each step. Your handler runs in both rounds.

nos.detalhe: The model calls reservar_vaga with class and email. There is no answer from the user yet.
The handler sees that the confirmation is missing and returns inputRequired({ inputRequests: { confirmar: inputRequired.elicit(...) } }). Nothing was booked.
The client shows the message to the person ("Reservar 1 vaga em…?") and collects a yes or a no.
The client calls the same tool again, now with inputResponses. The client SDK does this on its own when you register the elicitation/create handler.
acceptedContent validates the answer with the same schema. Yes: it books the seat. No: it returns isError and nothing changes.

secoes.legenda: Before (2025): the server started elicitation/create, sampling and roots on its own. In 2026-07-28 this became MRTR, and Sampling and Roots are deprecated.

secoes.sub: Excerpt from kit/servidor.mjs. It is written to run on both rounds: it reads what has already arrived and asks only for what is missing.

secoes.titulo: See both rounds: yes and no
secoes.sub: The script shows the raw 1st round (without the client completing it on its own) and then the normal flow.

abas.html:
1ª volta: resultType=input_required · pede: confirmar
[cliente] pergunta ao usuário: Reservar 1 vaga em "HTML semântico para agentes" para aluno@exemplo.com? → sim
resultado: reservado: html-01 para aluno@exemplo.com (restam 2) · isError=false
saída: 0

1ª volta: resultType=input_required · pede: confirmar
[cliente] pergunta ao usuário: Reservar 1 vaga em "HTML semântico para agentes" para aluno@exemplo.com? → nao
resultado: reserva cancelada pelo usuário · isError=true
saída: 1

A refusal becomes isError and exit code 1: the seat is still there.

secoes.titulo: Common mistake: a client that can't ask
secoes.sub: Without capabilities.elicitation, the server has no way to ask for the confirmation.

abas.html:
recusado: -32021 Cannot request input 'confirmar' (elicitation/create): the request's client capabilities do not declare the re
saída: 1

The message is cut off at 110 characters by the script itself (slice). The SDK refuses with -32021 before sending the request. In a real host, this means that client can't use the tool with confirmation: say so in the description or offer another path.

texto: inputResponses comes from the client. Validate it with a schema (acceptedContent does this) before acting.

The server is stateless: the 2nd round is a separate request. A multi-step flow keeps what has already been proven in requestState, signed with createRequestStateCodec (HMAC). It is signed, not encrypted: no secrets inside.
On a 2025 connection, the server SDK converts the input_required into an old-style elicitation/create (shim on by default). The same handler serves both eras.

secoes.sub: The yes, the no and a confirmation of your own.

exercicios.pronto: node teste-confirmacao.mjs nao → reserva cancelada pelo usuário · isError=true and saída: 1; with sim → reservado: html-01 and saída: 0. In both, the 1st line is resultType=input_required.

exercicios.texto: Run the client without the capability.
On your service's tool with consequences (lesson 3), ask for confirmation with inputRequired.elicit and handle the no. Copy teste-confirmacao.mjs, changing the name and arguments.
exercicios.pronto: your test with nao ends in saída: 1 without changing anything; with sim, in saída: 0.

perguntas.p: In the 2026-07-28 revision, how does the server ask the user for confirmation?
opcoes: Opening an elicitation/create request on its own
Returning resultType input_required in the response
Sending an email to the user
Asking the model to ask in the chat
perguntas.explica: The server no longer starts requests. It responds with input_required, and the client asks and repeats the call (MRTR).

perguntas.p: The user declined. What does the kit's handler do?
opcoes: Returns isError and does not reserve
Asks again, indefinitely, until the user says yes
Drops the connection and forces the client to start over
perguntas.explica: inputResponse shows an action other than accept; the handler returns isError and the seat is still there.

perguntas.p: A flow asks for confirmation and then for the scope. Where do you store the fact that the confirmation already happened?
perguntas.explica: Stateless, the server doesn't remember the previous round. requestState comes back identical from the client; sign it with createRequestStateCodec and store only what has already been proven.

perguntas.p: The client did not declare capabilities.elicitation and calls reservar_vaga. Result?
opcoes: The reservation goes through without confirmation
The SDK refuses with -32021 before sending
The client falls back to the 2025 revision
perguntas.explica: Each embedded request is checked against the client's capabilities. Without elicitation, it is refused with -32021.

itens.texto: input_required on the 1st round; the client asks and repeats.
Runs in both rounds; acts only on the validated yes.
